sections.text_helper: Section 31.6.12 "TIM counter (TIM_CNT)" in chapter 31 (Advanced-control timers (TIM1/TIM8)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1092.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x024
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bit 31 UIFCPY: UIF copy
This bit is a read-only copy of the UIF bit of the TIM_ISR register. If the UIFREMAP bit in the
TIM_CR1 is reset, bit 31 is reserved and read at 0.
Bits 30:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 CNT[15:0]: Counter value
Non-dithering mode (DITHEN = 0)
The register holds the counter value.
Dithering mode (DITHEN = 1)
The register only holds the non-dithered part in CNT[15:0]. The fractional part is not
available.
